records.title: Geschichte des Qorāns
records.author: Theodor Nöldeke; 2nd ed. Friedrich Schwally (Teil 1–2), Gotthelf Bergsträsser & Otto Pretzl (Teil 3)
records.edition: 1st ed. Göttingen: Dieterich, 1860 (Preisschrift); 2nd ed. Leipzig: Dieterich: T.1 Über den Ursprung des Qorāns (1909), T.2 Die Sammlung des Qorāns (1919), T.3 Die Geschichte des Korantexts (1926–1938). Reprint Hildesheim: Olms 1961. English: The History of the Qurʾān, tr. Wolfgang H. Behn, Leiden: Brill 2013.
records.coverage: whole Qurʾān; T.1 assigns every sūra to a period (1st/2nd/3rd Meccan, Medinan) with discussion

target_coverage.1: treated among the first-period Meccan sūras (placed late in that group) (from memory — verify)
target_coverage.22: discussed as a mixed sūra with Meccan and Medinan parts (from memory — verify)
target_coverage.87-114: mostly first Meccan period; 98 and 110 treated as Medinan; 112–114 first Meccan (from memory — verify)

open_access.what: 2nd ed. Teil 1 (1909), Univ. of Toronto scan; archive.org: NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT
2nd ed. Teil 2 (1919), same series (archive.org metadata: volume 2, '1909-38')
1st ed. 1860 (Google scan); NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT

records.licence: Public domain in life+70 jurisdictions for Nöldeke (d. 1930), Schwally (d. 1919), Bergsträsser (d. 1933); Teil 3 co-author Pretzl d. 1941 → PD since 2012. Behn's English translation (Brill 2013) is in copyright. Not downloaded (pointer only).
records.notes: Teil 3 (Bergsträsser–Pretzl, 1926–38) not found as a separate open scan on archive.org (only the 1961 Olms reprint, lending-restricted). The Corpus Coranicum commentary cites it as GdQ1/GdQ2 and builds its 'Datierung' on Nöldeke's periods (see CORPUSCORANICUM). Pointer record only: no local text (no segments.jsonl). Anything cited from this work is model memory and must be marked as such; verify against the book before relying on it.

records.title: The Composition of the Qur'an: Rhetorical Analysis
records.author: Michel Cuypers
records.edition: London: Bloomsbury Academic, 2015 (tr. Jerry Ryan); French orig. La composition du Coran, Pendé: Gabalda, 2012. Most relevant for the target sūras: Une apocalypse coranique: une lecture des trente-trois dernières sourates du Coran (Gabalda, 2014) / A Qurʾānic Apocalypse: A Reading of the Thirty-Three Last Sūrahs of the Qurʾān (Atlanta: Lockwood Press, 2018) — sūras 82–114.
records.coverage: rhetorical structure (parallelism, concentric composition) of sūras; the 2014/2018 book covers 82–114

target_coverage.81-114: per-sūra rhetorical structure in the AnIsl/MIDEO articles below and in A Qurʾānic Apocalypse
target_coverage.1: al-Fātiḥa analysed in The Composition of the Qur'an (from memory — verify)
